title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 32, Chapter 154 - Homestead Property Tax Credit and Renter Credit
deposited: 32 V.S.A. ch. 154, whole chapter (Homestead Property Tax Credit and Renter Credit): household income as modified federal AGI with Social Security and cash public assistance added back (6061), the property tax credit and the renter credit (6066, 6066a), claims (6068). The page sets out both the version in force until a contingency is met and the version effective July 1, 2029 if it is met, and several subdivisions in versions before and after July 1, 2027; all versions are kept.
